problem_elimination_pass.final_goal: Capture prospective official E-layer disclosures without weekend, holiday or non-trading-day observation gaps while keeping collection simple and deterministic.
hard_constraints: Preserve the three-calendar-day overlapping scan window.
Preserve announcement_id deduplication and append-only observation semantics.
Preserve V2.8.4 classifier, triage, identity and effective-date rules.
Do not open outcome research, price/return research, fold3/fold4, Setup, First60, Episode or live execution.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_assumption_removed: Official disclosures needing capture occur only on Monday-Friday trading days and can therefore be collected only Tuesday-Saturday mornings.
problem_elimination_pass.counterexample: A disclosure published after the Saturday 09:00 run or on Sunday can fall outside a later three-calendar-day scan if Sunday and Monday scheduled runs do not exist.
problem_elimination_pass.replacement: Run once every calendar day at 09:00 Asia/Shanghai. Empty/no-new-disclosure days are harmless no-ops because announcement_id deduplication remains authoritative.

unchanged_research_semantics: V2.8.12 shadow event identity and recurrence semantics
